svg.aria-label: Two pipelines, one environment, one public snapshot
svg.title: Two pipelines, one environment, one public snapshot
svg.text: Two pipelines, one environment, one public snapshot
Every merge reaches staging on its own · production and the public snapshot wait for a hand · the two repositories call each other only through pipeline triggers and job-token clones
job token · qa engine cloned from app main
Pipeline definitions are read from the default branch: a merge request cannot edit the pipeline that reviews it
